notes: Focused on Ampere workstation GPUs that remain current CUDA targets and are practical used-market local-LLM candidates.
Used prices are point-in-time observations and are also stored separately in the corresponding JSONL price-observation file.
Model-size guidance is approximate capacity guidance, not a benchmark guarantee; KV cache, context length, runtime overhead and quantization materially affect fit.
Bandwidth-per-watt and price-efficiency fields are specification/price-derived ratios, not measured LLM tokens-per-watt.

hardware.form_factor: 4.4 in H x 9.5 in L, single-slot, full-height

practical: INT8/INT4 Tensor Core paths via supported CUDA libraries
quantization.caveat: Exact kernel and datatype support depends on runtime/version; Tensor Core precision support does not imply every quantization format is accelerated.

hardware.model_fit_guidance: Comfortable for many 7B-14B quantized models and selected larger models with aggressive quantization/offload; 16GB VRAM is generally insufficient for a typical 30B-class model entirely in VRAM once runtime and KV-cache overhead are included.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: Strong for compact CUDA inference where 16GB is enough; active cooling, ECC and a single-slot 140W design are unusually practical.

pricing.note: Representative active used listing from current eBay Canada search results; marketplace pricing varies by seller, OEM, condition and shipping.

hardware.form_factor: 4.4 in H x 10.5 in L, dual-slot, full-height

nvlink.note: Two-card memory scaling to 40GB is application-dependent; ordinary LLM runtimes do not automatically expose NVLink-connected VRAM as one transparent pool.

practical: INT8/INT4 Tensor Core paths via supported CUDA libraries
quantization.caveat: Exact kernel and datatype support depends on runtime/version; NVLink does not make multi-GPU model sharding automatic.

hardware.model_fit_guidance: Well suited to 7B-14B models and many approximately 20B-class quantized workloads; selected larger models may require aggressive quantization or CPU/multi-GPU offload. The 20GB pool provides materially more KV-cache/context headroom than 16GB cards.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: Strong used-market CUDA candidate when 20GB capacity and 640GB/s bandwidth justify higher power than RTX A4000.

pricing.note: Representative active pre-owned listing in current eBay Canada search results; marketplace pricing and seller location vary.
